Privacy notice

Updated 11 November 2026

This notice explains how YMG Events handles visits and inquiries at events.ymgconsultingservices.com.

1. Who is responsible

The data controller is Frederic David, operating under the Your Magic Genie / YMG Events brand in Genova, Italy, P.IVA 03044510992. For privacy questions and requests, email hello@ymgconsultingservices.com.

2. Website visits and security

Cloudflare delivers and protects the website. It processes connection information, including IP address, request time, requested URL, browser and technical security signals, to serve pages, diagnose faults and prevent abuse. Our legitimate interest in a secure, available service is the basis for this processing (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR). We do not intentionally log inquiry bodies.

Fonts and the founder portrait are hosted with the website. The event hero is also served with the website; viewing it does not send an image request to Unsplash. We do not embed social feeds. Following an external link takes you to a service with its own privacy notice.

3. Contact and event inquiries

We process the name, reply email, inquiry type, organization or venue where relevant, selected format and any guest estimate, timing, budget or message you choose to provide. Name, reply email and inquiry type are needed for online inquiries; an organization name is required for venue and corporate requests. Other planning details are optional. Please avoid sensitive information and other people’s personal details.

When online sending is available, the form sends your brief to our same-origin Cloudflare service. Cloudflare Turnstile checks technical browser and connection signals to reduce automated abuse; the server verifies the result and applies IP-based rate controls. An authenticated Google Apps Script relay sends the inquiry to our Google Workspace mailbox at hello@ymgconsultingservices.com. The website has no separate inquiry database. If online sending is unavailable, you can use the displayed email address; your email provider then handles transmission. A form acknowledgement means the service accepted the request for processing, rather than proof of final inbox delivery.

We use service and quotation requests to respond and take steps you request before an agreement (Article 6(1)(b)). For general correspondence and contacts acting for a business, our basis is the legitimate interest in answering relevant communications and arranging collaborations (Article 6(1)(f)). Records that must be retained by law are processed under Article 6(1)(c). We do not add inquirers to a marketing mailing list or make automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects.

4. Providers and international transfers

Cloudflare provides hosting, security and, for online sending, Turnstile. Google provides email and the delivery relay. Access is limited to the operator and service providers supporting these purposes; competent authorities may receive information where required by law. We do not sell inquiry data or publish it.

These providers operate internationally, including outside the European Economic Area. Their data-processing terms provide for applicable adequacy arrangements or standard contractual clauses and supplementary safeguards for restricted transfers. See Cloudflare’s data-processing terms, the Google Cloud Data Processing Addendum and Turnstile privacy information. Contact us for information about the safeguards relevant to your data and how to obtain a copy.

5. How long information is kept

Inquiries are kept while needed to answer the request, prepare or discuss a proposal and manage any resulting relationship. When the inquiry is closed and no follow-up is needed, correspondence is reviewed for deletion, except records necessary for an applicable legal obligation or a specific dispute. The latter are restricted to that purpose until the obligation or dispute ends. There is no separate website submissions archive.

Cloudflare’s standard Workers Logs retention is three days on Free and up to seven days on Paid plans. These are operational logs, not a blanket retention period for every Cloudflare service. Essential security processing and provider deletion/backup cycles follow the relevant service terms. You can ask us about information still held about you.

6. Cookies and measurement

The site does not use advertising pixels or marketing cookies. Optional conversion measurement is disabled. The site itself does not store analytics identifiers on your device. Essential Cloudflare security features may process technical signals or use a security cookie; Turnstile pre-clearance is not requested by this application. Blocking these checks can prevent online sending; email remains available. We will update this notice before introducing optional tracking.

7. Your rights

Subject to the conditions in the GDPR, you may request access, correction, erasure, restriction and portability, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. Where processing relies on consent, it may be withdrawn without affecting earlier lawful processing. Email the controller using the address above. We normally respond within one month; where the GDPR permits an extension, we will explain it. You may lodge a complaint with the Italian authority, the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali.

8. Scope and changes

This notice concerns YMG Events. Other YMG websites have their own services and notices. Changes to this website’s processing will be reflected here with an updated date.
